mapper.select: select * from zqzt_sys_dept where dept_id = #{deptId} union select t.* from (select * from zqzt_sys_dept where parent_id is not null) t, (select @parent_id := #{deptId}) pd where FIND_IN_SET(parent_id,@parent_id) > 0 and @parent_id := CONCAT(@parent_id,',',dept_id)
mapper.update: UPDATE zqzt_sys_dept SET ancestors = CAST(dept_id AS CHAR(500)) WHERE parent_id = 0 OR parent_id IS NULL OR parent_id = dept_id

UPDATE zqzt_sys_dept t1 JOIN zqzt_sys_dept t2 ON t1.parent_id = t2.dept_id SET t1.ancestors = CONCAT(t2.ancestors, ',', t1.dept_id) WHERE t1.ancestors = '' AND t2.ancestors != '' AND t2.ancestors IS NOT NULL
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM zqzt_sys_dept t1 LEFT JOIN zqzt_sys_dept t2 ON t1.parent_id = t2.dept_id WHERE t1.ancestors = '' AND t1.parent_id IS NOT NULL AND t1.parent_id != t1.dept_id AND t2.ancestors != '' AND t2.ancestors IS NOT NULL
mapper.update: UPDATE zqzt_sys_dept SET level = ( CASE WHEN ancestors IS NULL OR ancestors = '' THEN 0 ELSE (LENGTH(ancestors) - LENGTH(REPLACE(ancestors, ',', '')) + 1) END )
